name: APIShare
description: APIShare lists zero-cost promotional models in its marketplace.
overview: APIShare lists selected zero-cost marketplace routes, including a promotional Qwen route, and one signup credit. The promotion duration and daily cap are not published and the displayed Qwen rate limit conflicts between 5 and 2 requests per minute. Do not treat the promotion as permanent; card requirement is unconfirmed. Marketplace routes and upstream terms may change.
free_access: Promotion end and daily cap not published
notes: Confirm the live marketplace route, limits and cost before use; promotional access may end.
